title: stores contract
description: The app's client-state facts, read by the state-management-zustand checker (check-stores.mjs).

crossStoreWrites.description: Names of the functions or repository methods whose one transaction changes rows that more than one store holds (removeList deletes a list and its tasks; resetAllData; an import). A call of one of them is allowed only inside the write argument of updateAndPublish(stores, write), in the data folder, or in tests.

osMirrorStores.description: Repo-relative files that may create a store at module level: a mirror of operating-system state that is never persisted (accessibility-as-code's src/ui/a11y/system-a11y-store.ts). Every other store comes from a factory.
